data.name: Poison Conversion
data.description: By spending 1 minute, the underground chemist can convert 1 dose of poison from its current type (contact, ingested, inhaled, or injury) to another type. For example, the underground chemist can convert a dose of Small centipede poison (an injury poison) to an inhaled poison. This process requires an alchemy lab.
